app.tagline: Forge boot sticks – no ISO hunting
forge.hint.need_variant: Choose a distribution and variant first.
catalog.fallback.cache: Online catalog unreachable – using the last saved version.
catalog.fallback.bundled: Online catalog unreachable – using the built-in version, which may be outdated.
error.server: The server responded with an error.
error.no_match: The latest version could not be found. The download page has probably changed – the catalog needs an update.
error.not_supported_yet: Will be supported in a later version.
error.insecure: The source is not secure (no HTTPS) and was blocked.
error.catalog_not_loaded: The catalog has not been loaded yet.
error.unknown_variant: This variant does not exist in the catalog.
prepare.from_cache: Already downloaded – re-verified, no download needed.
prepare.assurance.signed: Authenticity confirmed: checksum and vendor signature match.
prepare.assurance.checksum: Checksum matches. The vendor does not provide a signature.
prepare.assurance.weak: Only MD5 checked – detects transfer errors but not tampering.
prepare.cancelled: Cancelled. The partial download is kept and will be resumed next time.
error.checksum_mismatch: Checksum mismatch! The file is corrupted or tampered with and has been deleted.
error.signature_invalid: The vendor signature is invalid. For safety nothing was downloaded or the file was deleted.
error.checksum_missing: No checksum exists for this file. Nothing is used without a checksum.
